policies.title: Battery warranty
policies.text: The battery is covered for 24 months from the date of purchase. A battery that holds less than 70 percent of its rated capacity within that period has a defect. Damage from a charger the maker did not supply is not covered.

policies.title: Motor warranty
policies.text: The hub motor is covered for 24 months from the date of purchase. Noise alone is not a defect unless the motor also loses power. Water damage from submerging the bike is excluded.

policies.title: Frame warranty
policies.text: The frame is covered for 60 months against cracks and failed welds. Damage from a crash, or from loads above the rated weight, is excluded.

policies.title: Wear parts
policies.text: Tyres, brake pads and the chain are wear parts. Wear parts are not covered, whatever the age of the bike.

policies.title: Automatic approval limit
policies.text: The claims agent may approve a claim of up to 400 pounds on its own. A handler decides every approval above 400 pounds.

policies.title: Evidence a claim needs
policies.text: A claim needs the purchase date, the serial number, and a photo or diagnostic report of the fault. A claim without this evidence is referred to a handler.

policies.title: Controller and display warranty
policies.text: The controller and the display are covered for 24 months from the date of purchase. A display with dead pixels has a defect only if it can no longer be read.

policies.title: Paying an approved claim
policies.text: An approved claim is paid to the card used for the purchase within 10 working days of the decision.
